_comment: Synthetic English ham used ONLY to evaluate the comment spam filter, never as training data. It exists to measure the failure mode that made the imported python-podcast model unusable: its ham class is almost entirely German, so English ham scored as spam at p=1.0. Each entry is already in SpamFilter.comment_to_message shape ('{name} {email} {title} {comment}'). Emails use reserved example domains. See docs/spam-filter.md.
